rationale: No supported optimization applies to this workflow without risking coverage or violating preconditions. The workflow already caches npm dependencies via `actions/setup-node` with `cache: npm`, which satisfies the dependency-cache optimization (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE); adding another cache would be redundant under its contraindication "An equivalent cache already exists." The only other plausible candidate, P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT, requires representative successful-duration history, but the repository CI history is explicitly "not_a_measured_baseline" with only two runs and no durations, so an informed timeout cannot be derived and a valid slow `npm ci` run could exceed an arbitrary limit. The remaining patterns (matrix fail-fast, scheduled-run suppression, Bazel, test/build selection) do not apply to this single-job Copilot setup workflow. Preserving the existing steps and permissions avoids unrelated changes.
